notes: Round 7 per yourinteriordes_channel_triage_20260903.md. FULL, fact_yield 33 - the round's lowest - promotional_ratio HIGH but fully disclosed, manual ru track, 23 minutes. A visit to the decorative-coatings workshop 'Plast-Klass' with the specialist Olesya, a long-standing commercial partner (stated on camera), plus a project manager Yulya who runs an on-camera stain test on their own product. I SELECTED THIS SOURCE SPECIFICALLY TO CHECK AN ASSERTION I MADE IN ROUND 6, AND THE ASSERTION WAS WRONG. In Round 6 I recorded the January 2021 claim that lacquered decorative plaster is usable in a shower zone and as a splashback, and added 'and he narrows this claim himself in later sources'. I had no source for that narrowing - I inferred it because the claim seemed too bold, and wrote the inference as though it were established. This source does the opposite: it confirms and SPECIFIES the capability, attributing it to a polyurethane top lacquer rated for a high-humidity room and pressure-washable, with the worked example being a rest zone adjacent to a hammam - NOT a direct shower-spray zone. So the honest position is narrower than either of my formulations: upheld for humid rooms with that finish, unevidenced for direct spray. And the mechanism reframes the whole question, because the performance comes from the FINISH COAT rather than the plaster - so 'is decorative plaster washable' is the wrong question and 'which finish coat is specified' is the right one. The general lesson is the one worth keeping: I hedged a bold claim with an unevidenced 'he qualifies this later', which is worse than either recording the bold claim with a flag or leaving the question open. THE BEST TRANSFERABLE FINDING IS THE SAMPLE-VERSUS-AREA PROBLEM: a finish anyone can execute on a sample board can be beyond a non-specialist at room scale, because the failure mode - blotching from uneven lightening - only appears over area. Therefore a sample is NOT evidence that your painter can do it, which is the materials-side version of the shadow-skirting competence problem the vault records four times. That combines uncomfortably with the source's other notable feature: the host asks THREE TIMES how an ordinary client can tell a good decorator and never gets a checkable test, only 'go to professionals' and 'come and handle samples'. The non-answer is itself the finding, and the contrast with Round 6's furniture works manager - who gave a free, concrete, client-runnable test - is sharp and is information about the two trades. Also valuable: Venetian plaster retired with exactly one surviving use (hand-painted marble imitation by an artist under Venetian wax), which is a third option in the marble-versus-granite thread and yields a free competence signal, since a painter who calls your finish 'venetsianka' is offering a 1990s technique; substrate prep itemised by finish type, which completes the October 2022 economics (textured plaster saves the paint-prep stack and pays for it in trowel labour); a x2 labour coefficient for any decorative finish on a ceiling with a stated four-hour daily limit on overhead work; and textured plaster as an animal-proof surface with a behavioural mechanism - a cat gets no purchase and loses interest - which answers the cat-shredded ventilation shaft from his previous flat and qualifies the January 2021 line that pets are contraindicated. Every performance claim here is the supplier's, about her own product, and is routed with that flag; the checkable items are routed as usable.

notes: Round 1 per vasilysanuzel_channel_triage_20260908.md. FULL, fact_yield 13 from NINE MINUTES - the highest density per minute of the round, and the cheapest pick on the shortlist. REGION IS LEVEL 1: he says he does bathroom renovations in the city of Moscow in the source own content, which also settles the channel city. The scarcest content type in this vault delivers exactly what it promised: FIVE defects after a year of daily use and NOT ONE is workmanship. Two are purchases (a pan whose bowl retains solids, so the household now keeps a paper bin; a basin that sits too high), one is a component (the UFH thermostat failed three times while the cable was fine - and every replacement came from the same shop, which he himself flags as probably the same batch), one is under-provisioning (storage was planned, built, and is still not enough - and his fix is MORE of the same niches, not something different), and the best one is an INTERLOCK: he routinely energises the hygienic shower through the main lighting circuit, the owners then bought a lamp-lit mirror AFTER handover and now use it as the evening light, so with only the mirror on the hygienic shower does not work. An item bought after handover silently disabled a decision made at rough stage. ASR is 2022-era and poor - one room dimension was discarded as unrecoverable rather than reconstructed, and no brand name was taken from this source.

source_title: Ванная в панельке П-44. Подготовка объекта. Замена труб. Возведение стен. Серия 1
scope: Vasily_Sanuzel Round 2 video 1 of 6 - P-44T series episode 1
notes: Round 2 per vasilysanuzel_channel_triage_20260908.md. FULL, fact_yield 24, promotional_ratio MEDIUM - the only medium of the round, and the reason is an integrity finding rather than tone: a quarter of the video is a guided tour of the OSTENDORF factory, introduced with the unsupported superlative 'самая лучшая канализация которая вообще существует'. THAT MATTERS BECAUSE OSTENDORF IS THE FIRST STAND IN THE ROUND 1 MANUFACTURER Q&A, where their specialist gave what that note called the best answer in the video. The relationship pre-dates the interview by nine months. Recorded in both notes: the mechanism-level answers still stand on their own logic, but every unfalsifiable figure in that source is now marketing carried by a customer rather than testimony from a neutral questioner. TWO GENUINELY NEW TECHNIQUES. (a) A SACRIFICIAL BONDED SKIN over a load-bearing wall you are forbidden to chase - aerated block GLUED to the face, services chased into the skin, and the bonding is the whole point because the chase cuts almost through it and an unbonded skin would collapse; no plumb or level chasing needed because the skin's job is to be cuttable, not flat. This is the direct answer to the monolithic-wall-cannot-be-chased blocker the vault already records. (b) The lintel: two blocks foam-glued, a chase cut along it, two metal studs bedded in against diagonal cracking - the vault had nothing on lintels. Also the non-obvious blockwork rules: check level from ONE face only because blocks vary in thickness, and the 1-2cm wall gap is sized for a foam gun's nozzle, not as a tolerance. AND A DATED TWO-SIDED DISAGREEMENT OPENED: he says bore reduction causes noise; Ostendorf's rep declined that framing nine months later. Both recorded as Perspectives, unresolved, with the practical answer unaffected.

source_title: Ванная в панельке П-44. Выравнивание стен и пола. Штукатурка. Стяжка. Как это делаю я. Серия 2
scope: Vasily_Sanuzel Round 2 video 2 of 6 - P-44T series episode 2
notes: Round 2 per vasilysanuzel_channel_triage_20260908.md. FULL, fact_yield 27, promotional_ratio low. Caption track is punctuated and much cleaner than his 2022 videos, so the quotations are more reliable. FOUR ITEMS CARRY THIS SOURCE. (1) THE BEACONS COME OUT: at 1.5-2h, when the plaster no longer sticks but still dents, he pulls the metal beacons and cuts the wall back floor-to-ceiling - the stated reason is to remove the bumps that form AROUND the beacon, because the beacon itself may be out of true. The beacon is a temporary reference, not part of the wall. Then fill the grooves while still damp, deliberately PROUD, and cut back once set, because otherwise it sinks and leaves a hollow. That step removes the rust-bleed failure mode the vault records from another channel rather than mitigating it. (2) A DATUM ARITHMETIC THAT CLOSES: reference is the existing threshold; screed top must sit 13mm below it, and he names the 13mm as tile plus adhesive; laser set so beam-to-existing-floor is 15.7cm makes the target exactly 17.0cm, and a reading of 18.3 means 13mm of pour there. The transferable trick is choosing the datum so the target is a whole number. (3) THE PLASTER IS DECIDED BY THE VENTILATION SHAFT: part of the room's enclosure is gypsum, and cement compositions must never go on it - so one element decides the plaster for the whole room, which recurs in every panel flat where the shaft forms a wall face. Plus his general rule that each layer must be weaker than its substrate. (4) The perimeter damper he only HEDGED in the PIK video is here a named product at 3mm, executed and cut off afterwards - a status upgrade from reasoning to practice. Also two straightedge types distinguished (H-profile applies, trapezoidal cuts back), and priming credited with keeping the MIX workable longer, not only with adhesion.

source_title: Ванная в панельке П-44. Монтаж трубопровода. Встроенные смесители. Каркас. Инсталляция. 4 серия
scope: Vasily_Sanuzel Round 2 video 3 of 6 - P-44T series episode 4
notes: Round 2 per vasilysanuzel_channel_triage_20260908.md. FULL, fact_yield 28, promotional_ratio low - almost entirely technique, and he CRITICISES a product he is installing (a concealed mixer whose mounting plate is not machined flat, so it rocks however it is fixed). THE SUPPLIER PICTURE FROM ROUND 1 IS NOW MUCH CLEARER AND WORSE: he installs Elson pipe and builds the carcass from profil TC, so THREE OF THE FOUR STANDS in the 2024 'Proizvoditel otvetit' video - Ostendorf, Elson and the profile maker - are his own working suppliers. That video is closer to a supplier round-up than to an independent interview and its framing oversells its independence. The three mechanism-level answers still stand on their own logic; every unfalsifiable claim in it is now marketing carried by a customer. A PERSPECTIVES SPLIT OPENED, and deliberately not smoothed: he mounts the wall-hung WC module INTO THE PROFILE CARCASS ONLY, with no floor bearing at all, against a rule this vault holds from Kruglov and confirms from Sidorik that the frame's feet must rest on the structural slab. It is a different structural concept - load redistributed into many wall fixings, with a frame model sold for that mounting - not the same one done badly, and neither side offers a load figure. BEST SINGLE PASSAGE: the concealed-mixer serviceability answer, which addresses the fear with anatomy - the valves, seals, cartridge, lever and thermostat are all reachable through the embedded box (the plaster is held back so the opening survives), and what is permanently buried is only the brass body, which is a solid piece of metal. Plus the depth rule that catches people: 50-70mm ALREADY INCLUDES the tile. Also a fourth pressure-test protocol variant with the physics stated, and two unrecoverable-if-missed lifehacks around the towel rail.

source_title: Ванная в панельке П-44. Монтаж трапа. Душевой поддон за 3 дня. Зачем нужна гидроизоляция? 5 серия
scope: Vasily_Sanuzel Round 2 video 4 of 6 - P-44T series episode 5
notes: Round 2 per vasilysanuzel_channel_triage_20260908.md. FULL, fact_yield 30, promotional_ratio low, and the joint-densest of the round. THE WATERPROOFING SECTION CLOSES A LOOP OPEN SINCE EPISODE 1 AND IS THE BEST PASSAGE OF THE WHOLE CHANNEL SO FAR. He half-refutes the standard justification - the probability of flooding your neighbours is negligible, the membrane's main job is to protect YOUR OWN substrate - and then names the entry vector: every deliberate movement gap left in episodes 1-4 (block-to-wall, block-to-ceiling, plaster-to-structure, board cut-outs) is exactly where water gets in. THE GAPS AND THE MEMBRANE ARE ONE DESIGN, NOT TWO STEPS. Then the scope finding: because the room was plastered in GYPSUM (forced by the gypsum ventilation shaft, episode 2), and gypsum plaster does not bond with cement tile adhesive, the membrane is ALSO the bonding intermediary - manufacturers do not accept gypsum plaster as a tile substrate EXCEPT under acrylic polymer waterproofing - so he coats every wall floor to ceiling rather than the wet zone only. A PLASTER CHOSEN FOR AN UNRELATED REASON SILENTLY EXPANDED THE WATERPROOFING SCOPE TO THE WHOLE ROOM. And the QC test a client can actually perform: thickness is the specification (0.5-0.8mm), it is invisible, colour proves nothing ('all blue means done', said his customer), so COUNT THE EMPTY CONTAINERS AGAINST THE DATASHEET - his own figure is about 18kg for this room. Too thin does not merely underperform; it is why membranes come away in sheets. Also: a linear trap's cover carries its own fall so no envelope has to be formed at all, and a three-layer three-day tray recipe whose working property is FAST DRYING rather than fast setting.

source_title: Ванная в панельке П-44. Попал на деньги. Укладываю керамогранит. Эпоксидная затирка. 6 серия
scope: Vasily_Sanuzel Round 2 video 5 of 6 - P-44T series episode 6
notes: Round 2 per vasilysanuzel_channel_triage_20260908.md. FULL, fact_yield 30, promotional_ratio low. FIRST PRICE FROM THIS CHANNEL, AND IT IS THE PRICE OF HIS OWN MISTAKE: a single 180x90 porcelain slab was ordered to cut a 120x90 podium from, he cut it wrong, and he paid for the replacement himself - 12,000 RUB, about $130 on the trailing-6-month USD/RUB mean to the publish date. The corrective is filmed and is the transferable part: on the replacement he PRACTISES THE CUT ON THE UNNEEDED OFFCUT EDGE first, then cuts to size, plus 1mm. On a single-unit slab order the offcut is the rehearsal. The same cut exposed a dimensional trap - the 90cm had to lose a further strip each side because the stainless drain insert has its own thickness. A PERSPECTIVES PAIR OPENED ON EPOXY GROUT, and it resolves into a placement rule rather than a winner: Sinchukov (2022) argues against epoxy on cost (x3-4 material, x2 labour) and because errors are unrecoverable; this working tiler says any master's objection to epoxy means he cannot work with it or last worked with it long ago, CONCEDES the cost premium, and then demonstrates the four-stage film removal that answers the unrecoverability argument. COMMON GROUND IS LARGER THAN IT LOOKS: both agree on the cost premium and both point the client at the tiler. AND THEY RECONCILE - he does NOT use epoxy in internal corners, silicone goes there, which is exactly the rule that was broken in the bath-rim leak case that hardens the other side's position. Independent support from his own one-year revisit, where the silicone corners were intact. Also the clearest adhesive explainer in the vault: the invisible BOW is why class matters, S1 elasticity is the CURED deformability and not plasticity, and a 12mm notch gives 3mm of adhesive - DIVIDE THE NOTCH BY FOUR. Note a real divergence from Kruglov on where C1 stops: 30x30 here against a 60cm long side there - take the tighter limit near the boundary.

source_title: Технический проект санузла. Как посчитать материал и не ошибиться?
scope: Vasily_Sanuzel Round 2 video 6 of 6 - the material take-off video the whole series pointed at
notes: Round 2 per vasilysanuzel_channel_triage_20260908.md. FULL, fact_yield 24, promotional_ratio low. THE VIDEO THE WHOLE SERIES POINTED AT - three episodes turn on a full-scale model drawn before anything is ordered and none of them shows how it is built or what it produces. He opens by limiting his own authority: design 'is not a builder's job, it is a designer's thing' and doing it is 'of course also not obligatory' - he does it because he works alone. BOTH HIS STATED REASONS ARE ABOUT QUANTITIES, NOT DRAWINGS, and clash detection is secondary in his own ordering. THE TAKE-OFF WORKFLOW IS WHAT THIS VAULT HAD NOTHING ON: the model's report returns quantity, article number and name for almost 100 positions, exported to Excel and hand-edited because he uses a different sewer system than the library's; then A SEPARATE SHEET TAKES EACH PIECE'S LENGTH AND COUNT AND RETURNS BOTH THE NUMBER OF STOCK LENGTHS AND THE CUTTING PLAN. Worked and consistent: 38 three-metre sticks, 114m ordered, 113.14m consumed, 86cm of total offcut waste - under 1 percent on a large framing package, by nesting rather than by ordering generously. That is the concrete answer to the waste-allowance question every material line in 11_Budget otherwise handles with a percentage. The scoping discipline is half the method: pipes, hinges and an unreachable third riser are deliberately NOT modelled, while FIXINGS now are - and he names that as a change in his own practice. TWO RETAIL QUOTES FOR THE SAME ASSEMBLY: 366,000 RUB for the steel TC system against 265,000 for an aluminium 'full analogue' - a 101,000 RUB (about $1,100) or 28 percent delta on an identical bill of quantities, visible only because the take-off existed first. Both are retail list and he expected a supplier discount, so they are ceilings. AND THIS RE-READS THE TRADE-SHOW VIDEO: the evasive 'buy more' answer he got from that profile maker's director was to a question he asked as a customer standing on a six-figure decision between these two systems. The evasiveness stands as the finding; the question was serious.

source_title: Постановление Совета Министров Республики Беларусь от 3 апреля 2026 г. № 164 «О переустройстве и перепланировке, установке на крышах и фасадах многоквартирных жилых домов индивидуальных антенн и иных конструкций»
scope: Dedicated primary-source legislative pass on 16_Legal_and_Regulations, held open since 2026-08-24. Read in full, 15 pages.
notes: THE DEDICATED LEGISLATIVE TASK 16_Legal_and_Regulations WAS EXPLICITLY HELD OPEN FOR. Primary PDF supplied by the owner from his own download; archived with sha256 and read in full. Level 1 by construction - this is Belarusian law, not a practitioner account of it. TWO FRAMING CORRECTIONS THAT CHANGE HOW EVERY OLDER SOURCE READS: it REPEALS postanovlenie No. 384 of 2013 IN FULL (plus eleven partial repeals), so every guide, article and video citing 384 is superseded; and it is a Council-of-Ministers postanovlenie under Housing Code art. 5, NOT a presidential decree, which matters because it sits under the Code and can be replaced the same way. THE SINGLE MOST USEFUL LINE IS THE LAST SENTENCE OF PARA 3: the definition of pereustroystvo/pereplanirovka is a CLOSED list, and 'inye raboty ne yavlyayutsya rabotami po pereustroystvu' - so finishes, tiling, screed over screed, sanitaryware swapped in place, sockets, lighting and furniture need no permit at all. But note insulation works ARE on the list, which is counter-intuitive. TWO TRACKS: proekt plus tekhnicheskie usloviya ONLY for gas and central heating; partitions, openings in non-load-bearing walls and insulation need ispolkom soglasovanie WITHOUT a project. So for this flat the partition work needs a permit but no designer - and moving a radiator would flip the whole job into the project track. The widely repeated claim that you must obtain TU from the power utility for high-wattage appliances IS NOT SUPPORTED; what para 4 imposes instead is a prohibition on exceeding the premises' design calculated loads. Para 14 EXPRESSLY PERMITS SELF-PERFORMANCE, which is directly relevant to a self-managed project, and requires that any contractor engaged have construction as its MAIN activity - a real screening criterion. SCHEDULE-CRITICAL: the acceptance commission is appointed by the ispolkom not less than 30 CALENDAR DAYS before it begins, so the last month of the programme is administrative; and para 20 makes the submitted plan-skhema the standard the works are measured against, which is what makes late design changes expensive for documentary rather than construction reasons. Para 10 puts the waste and material-storage rules, and the completion and acceptance dates, INTO THE PERMIT ITSELF - so the operative waste rule for a given renovation is issued to the owner by name, not found in general legislation. CLOSES A STANDING OPEN QUESTION: Polozhenie 2 para 2 names 'oborudovanie, primenyaemoe dlya konditsionirovaniya vozdukha' in its own definition of 'individual antennas and other constructions', so a facade or roof AC outdoor unit requires soglasovanie from the TERRITORIAL ARCHITECTURE AND URBAN-PLANNING SUBDIVISION - not the ispolkom. That question had been open on the permits page since 2026-08-24 and had previously only a level-2 anecdote against it. AN AI-GENERATED ENGLISH SUMMARY SUPPLIED WITH THE PDF WAS NOT ADMITTED AS A SOURCE, only used as an index of claims to check: three confirmed, two confirmed with a material correction, two WRONG, and seven not addressed by this act at all. The seven unverified - including the SN 3.02.01-2020 wet-zone rule and the postanovlenie 399 noise window - are recorded as named open questions rather than written in. ONE AMBIGUITY DELIBERATELY LEFT UNRESOLVED: paras 18 and 23 exempt 'abzatsy vtoroy i tretiy chasti pervoy punkta 3' from the vedomost tekhnicheskikh kharakteristik, and the two available readings of abzats numbering put different works in that exemption. It decides whether THIS project needs one, and it is a real cost, so it is flagged on three pages as a question for the ispolkom rather than guessed.

source_title: СН 3.02.01-2019 «Жилые здания» — Строительные нормы Республики Беларусь (preview copy, Изменения №1 и №2 not included)
scope: Fetched to verify a quotation in the Gemini Deep Research report; became the second primary-source pass on 16_Legal_and_Regulations.
notes: FETCHED SPECIFICALLY TO VERIFY A QUOTED CLAUSE IN A RESEARCH REPORT, AND THE VERIFICATION PAID FOR ITSELF FOUR TIMES OVER. The report cited 'SN 3.02.01-2020 clause 4.11' with a verbatim Russian quote. The norm is SN 3.02.01-2019 (published 2020, which is likely how the year got wrong), the clause is 4.9, there is NO top-floor exception for sanitary units - the report fabricated one by conflating 4.9 with 4.8, which is about a living room over a GAS-STOVE kitchen, a different rule about a different pairing - and its quote OMITTED the two most useful provisions in the clause. THE FIRST OMISSION IS A PLANNING LEVER: partial placement of ONE of the sanitary unit's rooms, up to 25 percent of its area, over a living room IS permitted, conditional on enhanced waterproofing AND sound insulation of that floor construction - and note the cost, because those are 'ustroystvo gidro-, paro-, zvukoizolyatsii', which No. 164 s3 makes works requiring soglasovanie in their own right. THE SECOND OMISSION IS BINDING ON THIS FLAT: minimum plan dimensions 's uchetom otdelki' - after finishes - of 1.5x1.7m for a bathroom, 1.5x2.5m for a combined unit, both fitting a bath of at least 1.7m, 0.8x1.5m for a WC without a washbasin and 1.4x1.5m WITH one. So a washbasin in this flat's 1.24 m2 tualet CANNOT COMPLY, since the with-basin minimum implies 2.10 m2. That settles a design question rather than raising one. AND IT SURFACED A DISCREPANCY RECORDED AS A QUESTION RATHER THAN A FINDING: the only tualet dimension this vault holds is the non-movable ventblock at 1140 mm, which with the 1.24 m2 area puts the other dimension near 1.09 m - so on those figures NO dimension of the room reaches the norm's 1.5 m minimum. Three candidate explanations are recorded (the amendments changed it; the minimums bind new design under the norm then in force; or the area is a CAD recalculation and the shape differs) and none is chosen. The washbasin conclusion holds on all three. ALSO CARRIED: s4.7 makes a door ventilation grille of at least 0.02 m2 mandatory on kitchen, bathroom, WC and combined-unit doors, with its bottom edge no more than 0.03 m above the floor - a specification requirement on door selection; and s3.33's definition of a sanitary unit INCLUDES THE WASHING MACHINE, which matters for how a laundry position inside the wet room is assessed. CROSS-LINKED INTO 08_WC AND 07_Bathroom BECAUSE THE NORM IS MORE DEMANDING THAN THE PRACTITIONER METHODS ALREADY THERE: Zemskov's worked WC method gives a 1.0 m minimum length and 0.87 m finished width, and 1.0 m width once a basin is added - against which the norm wants 1.5 m of length and 1.4 m of width with a basin. Neither source alone gives the governing pair, and a WC built to the ergonomic minimum can be comfortable and still non-compliant. PROVENANCE CAVEAT CARRIED EVERYWHERE IT IS CITED: the copy read is a normy.by preview watermarked 'dlya oznakomleniya' and does NOT include Izmeneniya No. 1 and No. 2, which the norm is advertised as having - so every figure needs re-checking against the consolidated text, and that is the top follow-up. The norm is also a DESIGN norm per s4.1; it binds a renovation only indirectly, through No. 164 s4's prohibition on breaching stroitelnye trebovaniya.

source_title: Дизайнер Дмитрий К — «Технический дизайн-проект квартиры на Фестивальной в Remplanner: подробный обзор» (33:33)
scope: Round 1 of the design-toolchain group. Processed for CONVENTIONS AND INFORMATION MODELS, not as a tool recommendation.
notes: A SOURCE CLASS NEW TO THIS VAULT: a designer's client-facing progress report, published publicly on a 372-subscriber channel. Promotional ratio is low for a STRUCTURAL reason - the audience is his client, not the viewer, so there is nothing to sell and no tier to steer - and the matching limit is equally structural: one project, not a pattern across many, so the transferable content is his method rather than his decisions. THE HEADLINE IS THE STAGED WORKFLOW WITH ITS REASON: concept layout agreed with the clients, then the technical base built DELIBERATELY BEFORE detailed visualisation so the whole picture of the works forms while changes are cheap, then per-room renders. THE SECOND IS THE SERVICES DERIVATION, which is cap6 to cap8 performed aloud - every electrical point cited to a named appliance or a named routine, with a per-point note on the sheet saying what it serves, and the socket plan read with the furniture layer overlaid because a socket position is only meaningful against the object it serves. Per the gap analysis this pays twice: the derived count IS the ELE-01 BOM quantity, currently unmeasured. DOOR SWING IS SET BY SWITCH REACHABILITY, decided on the existing-layout sheet before any electrical drawing and on a flat with no pereplanirovka at all - a connect-the-dots derivation running backwards from the usual direction. ALL HEIGHTS ARE SINGLE-MENTION ASR CANDIDATES, NOT FIGURES: the transcript mangles posudomoechnoy as potudomochnoy and sanuzla as kanuzla, so 105/170/30 cm and the 80-100 mm ceiling drop each need cross-checking against the vault's existing socket-height pages before use. The 80-100 mm drop must NOT be reconciled with the vault's contested 27 mm figure - different datum, one a plasterboard minimum and one a service-routing allowance. LAYOUT CASE: kdmitry-festivalnaya-services. Its area of 100 m2 is LEVEL-2 METADATA from the channel's own sibling title wJjZHmNMHyo, not stated aloud anywhere, and room_count 3 is counted from the rooms he narrates - flagged in the case, and neither figure may derive a dimension.

source_title: Дизайнер Дмитрий К — «Технический дизайн проект квартиры в Remplanner — обзор с комментариями» (18:13)
scope: Round 1 format-repeat test: picked deliberately to find out whether the walkthrough format repeats or the first one happened to be the good one.
notes: THE FORMAT-REPEAT TEST PASSED, AND THE SHORTER VIDEO IS THE DENSER ONE - 18 minutes against 33, enumerating 18 tabs against 9. This confirms the corrected yield model from YourInteriorDes Round 3 (scope a round from which FORMATS remain, not from how many titles remain) on a channel of an entirely different kind. THE MOST VALUABLE OUTPUT IS A SECOND INDEPENDENT SHEET SET. Everything in Planning_Project_Deliverable_Set.md previously came from ONE architect, and that page's own line invites a second opinion - treat the sheet list as a checklist to argue with. This is that second opinion, and it immediately exposed an omission: WE HAVE NO A/C PLAN SHEET ANYWHERE, grep kondicioner returning 0 in both the deliverable set and the roadmap, while both of his projects ship a plan kondicionerov and use it to record a unit moved above a door served by a vyvod rather than a socket. Flagged as an owner decision, not a research one. HE ALSO STATES THE cap5 LINK WE HAD ONLY DESIGNED: the finish scheme also helps calculate the cost of the renovation - so that sheet pays into the budget as well as the drawings. AND HE STATES A SCOPE BOUNDARY: the stroitelnye plans are not the designer's deliverable, which is directly useful for deciding which of our 16 sheets a self-managed project with no designer actually needs. THE SWITCH GROUPING IS THE cap8 WORKED EXAMPLE the roadmap says the lighting sheet's whole value lies in - master plus two-way at the entrance, groups colour-coded with lines drawn to each, a dedicated switch for the floor navigation lights, shower light ganged with the extract fan, and a bedroom deliberately split into two groups FOR BRIGHTNESS REGULATION rather than zoning. He also notices a missing switch live on camera and says he will add it and reissue the guest link. THIS TRANSCRIPT IS THE WORST OF THE SIX AND CARRIES NO PUNCTUATION AT ALL, mangling Remplanner as rer, razvertki as otvertki and stena as pena - so a few room attributions in the socket and switch lists are read from context and are flagged as possibly off by one room. ONE CLAIM WAS DELIBERATELY NOT ROUTED AS A RULE: threshold-free wet rooms allegedly requiring waterproofing over the WHOLE FLAT's area. Consequential, single-source, on the poorest transcript, plausibly a compressed narrower rule - recorded flagged do-not-act-on pending a second source.

source_title: Дизайнер Дмитрий К — «Концепция двухкомнатной квартиры в Планоплане: обоснование планировочного решения» (15:03)
scope: Round 1: the obosnovanie format, picked because a title promising REASONING should out-yield one promising a result.
notes: THE FORMAT BET PAID OFF - nearly every layout move here comes with the client requirement or physical constraint that produced it. THE TRANSFERABLE FINDING IS METHODOLOGICAL AND IT ARGUES AGAINST ONE OF OUR OWN CONVENTIONS. Stated twice, addressed directly to his clients: at concept stage we are NOT developing the colour scheme, and all the colours and contrasts exist ONLY to make the planning concept legible - because naglyadnost is achieved through detail and contrast, and 3D is what makes a layout comprehensible at all. Planning_Project_Deliverable_Set.md records our 3D as massing in the same grey style, i.e. we resolved the honest-massing-versus-photoreal tension by going grey. HIS IS A THIRD ANSWER: use colour and contrast deliberately BECAUSE they aid comprehension, and neutralise the misreading risk with an explicit disclaimer. Grey massing avoids the misreading by discarding the legibility colour buys. Cheap to test since it is a render style, not a model change - recorded as an owner decision on the new conventions page. A REUSABLE RULE WITH THREE GAINS FROM ONE MOVE: where a window sill projects deeply, its projection IS the depth of a proper cabinet, so tall storage goes in the piers either side - giving the missing storage, concealing the radiator pipe otvody, and using the whole window wall, while the sill stays usable because the storage is beside it rather than over it. ALSO A RARE PIECE OF STORAGE HONESTY: he plans vitrines to rehouse a large Soviet stenka and says plainly it is far from certain they will hold everything, adding that a new interior always means losing some of the old things - the implied practice being to measure what exists before promising it a home. NO DIMENSIONS ANYWHERE IN THIS SOURCE: sill depth, cabinet depth, the fridge filler width and the rowing-machine clearance are all qualitative, so standing rule 9 applies to any figure later read off a frame. ONE ASR ERROR CORRECTED FROM A SIBLING VIDEO: this transcript renders the owner's exercise machine as gribnoy (nonsense) where TJVXUCKQ1UU renders it correctly as grebnoy, a ROWING machine - caught only by cross-reading two videos of the same project, which is an argument for processing a project's videos together.

source_title: Дизайнер Дмитрий К — «Как начать планировать небольшую квартиру: выбор дверей и перегородок: SketchUp и Планоплан» (7:24)
scope: Round 1: doors and partitions treated as one coupled problem rather than two.
notes: CONTAINS THE ROUND'S BEST RULE AND IT IS A DEPENDENCY OUR MODEL DOES NOT ENCODE: a partition's position is constrained by the CASING width of every door opening onto a circulation zone, on BOTH sides of each opening - so the partition is moved deeper or off the corner so casings are not cut and the door sits symmetrically. He applies it in three separate places on one flat. This is a finish decision propagating BACKWARDS into structural geometry, the same shape as the door-swing-from-switch rule, and it must be known before partitions are set. The 8-10 cm casing width is HIS ESTIMATE FOR A CLASSICAL STYLE, single ASR mention - the rule is the dependency, the number a placeholder until a product is chosen. AND NOTE THE TENSION HE HOLDS DELIBERATELY: doors are modelled WITHOUT casings because trim is a separate later layer chosen at komplektaciya, yet the trim is what constrains the partition. Only the dependency is reserved for, not the object. A CLOSING METHODOLOGICAL CLAIM THAT BEARS DIRECTLY ON OUR ROADMAP: final layout decisions can only be taken once all furniture, fittings and plumbing are placed - which says cap4 (furniture and appliances as real objects) is a PREREQUISITE for freezing a layout rather than a later decoration step, and is worth arguing with since this flat's layout is described as largely decided. TWO-VARIANT PRESENTATION DONE WELL: he states the case AGAINST his own combining variant first (the family is mnogodetnaya, two units are genuinely good) and still insists the alternative be examined, then enumerates concrete gains - the dividing wall's thickness recovered, one of two doors gone freeing wall runs on both sides, and the corridor jog absorbed so the combined room ends up larger. HE ALSO CORROBORATES ONE OF OUR OWN CONVENTIONS INDEPENDENTLY: variants are shown over the original layout as a visible underlay, which is our dashed-original-partitions rule reached separately. NO LAYOUT CASE COULD BE WRITTEN FOR THIS FLAT: its area is stated nowhere in any of its three videos, and layout-case.schema.json requires area_total_m2 on a single_apartment case, so six rules including the casing rule were DROPPED from rules.jsonl rather than backed by an invented figure. They live in this note and in Drawing_Conventions_From_Practice.md. That schema limitation cuts against the vault's own areas-are-not-evidence rule and is recorded in the Change Log.

source_title: Дизайнер Дмитрий К — «Как использовать Планоплан и SketchUp вместе для дизайна квартиры» (5:31)
scope: Round 1: the highest facts-per-minute source of the round at 5.5 minutes.
notes: THE CLEAREST MECHANISM IN THE WHOLE GROUP, AND IT IS A PATTERN RATHER THAN A PRODUCT RECOMMENDATION: geometric accuracy and content speed are separated into two tools and joined by an exported plan raster used as an underlay. SketchUp builds the accurate model from survey dimensions; its plan is exported as an image; the model is rebuilt over that underlay in the fast catalogue tool, whose ONLY claimed value is that furniture, textures and materials are all to hand so concept variants come out fast and a decision in principle arrives sooner; precise rework goes back to the accurate tool. THE LOAD-BEARING RATIONALE IS THAT AN ACCURATE MODEL CANNOT PRACTICALLY BE AUTHORED IN THE FAST TOOL - drawing one from scratch there is almost unreal, whereas over a good dimensioned underlay it can be done - so ACCURACY IS IMPORTED, NOT AUTHORED WHERE THE CONTENT LIVES. He rebuilds the same model twice on purpose and says the time is worth it. HIS STATED TOLERANCE OF PLUS-MINUS 1-2 CM MUST NOT BE ADOPTED: it is TIGHTER than our nominal plus-minus 50 mm for a reason that does not transfer, since he is modelling a flat that EXISTS and that he has MEASURED while this flat is NOT BUILT YET per PROVISIONAL_MODEL_POLICY.md. Different datum, different meaning - record the comparison, not the figure. THE MOST TRANSFERABLE FINDING IS WHAT A PLANNING MODEL MUST BE ACCURATE ABOUT, AND IT IS NOT VISUAL FIDELITY: hand-model anything absent from the catalogue AND size-critical, accept that it may look a little different, and insist that its overall dimensions be near-exact - because a placeholder cube defeats the model's purpose, which is legibility rather than inventory. THIS CONVERGES WITH THE GAP ANALYSIS FROM THE OPPOSITE DIRECTION: that document concluded from COST that the model's job is not dimensional exactness but holding quantities stable enough that a substitution re-prices correctly; this concludes from LEGIBILITY that you get the size right and leave the identity swappable. Two independent arguments landing on the same role-versus-identity split is worth more than either alone, and it is the same split the BOM already uses. ONE OPEN QUESTION THAT MATTERS TO US: he never says whether the exported plan raster carries a scale reference, and standing rule 9 requires a scale independent of the thing being measured - an underlay exported without one would fail our own discipline. ALSO SUPPLIED THE CORRECTION TO A SIBLING VIDEO'S ASR ERROR: grebnoy trenazher, a rowing machine, not gribnoy.

The 1 mm keyboard nudge is a tool capability and NOT a tolerance claim - do not read it as buildable precision. source_title: Justin Geis / TheSketchUpEssentials - "The RIGHT Way to Import Reference Images in SketchUp" (5:12)
scope: AI-agent modelling batch, Round 1. Read as a raster-registration procedure, not a tutorial.
notes: THE BEST VALUE-PER-MINUTE SOURCE OF EITHER TOOLCHAIN BATCH, AT FIVE MINUTES. It supplies the one check this project does not already have and it closes an open item raised on 2026-09-08. TWO-POINT SCALE VERIFICATION: register the raster against one known printed dimension, preferably a long one, then draw a separate line between two DIFFERENT features elsewhere in the drawing and check its measured length against its own printed value. In his words, and I always want to check, sometimes I like to draw a line somewhere else. THE DISTINCTION FROM CHAIN CLOSURE IS THE POINT AND IT IS NOT A RESTATEMENT: chain closure asserts that a run of dimensions sums to a known whole, whereas this asserts the REGISTRATION ITSELF against a printed figure that played no part in establishing it - the same independence principle that made vector_extent_oracle.py necessary after a coupled edit of the DXF and wall_blocks.csv passed the gate. AND THE SECOND FINDING INDEPENDENTLY CORROBORATES A DECISION THIS PROJECT HAD ALREADY TAKEN, which is a different kind of value from extending a page: if you are trying to model this building exactly you should not be using visuals to figure out where things go, you actually need to model using the dimensions - which is exactly the v0 route recorded in project_decisions.md, reconstruct the partitions from the PRINTED dimension strings using the registered raster. He demonstrates it by typing 36 ft 4 in, then 7 ft 2 in, then 2 ft 1 and a half in along the printed chain rather than clicking along the image. HE ALSO BOUNDS THE DISCIPLINE HONESTLY, which is worth keeping because it says where to spend effort: it is required only where the model must be exact, and if you are just trying to get it close enough it does not really matter. CLOSES OPEN ITEM 4 ON Drawing_Conventions_From_Practice.md - does the exported-underlay method preserve a scale reference? It does not, and it does not need to, because the underlay is orientation and the printed dimensions are the measurement. NO ERROR FIGURE IS GIVEN anywhere - his residual is pretty close, that is about as close as you are going to get - so the method is validated as a PROCEDURE and NO numeric registration tolerance may be derived from it. ONE INFERENCE OF OURS RATHER THAN HIS CLAIM, flagged in the note: a verification dimension parallel to the registration one tests scale but not squareness, so a perpendicular one is probably the stronger check. Natively English; en-orig used. Standing rule 1 forbids a TRANSLATED track, not a source's own language.

source_title: Aaron Dietzen / Trimble SketchUp - "3 Ways to Convert 2D Floorplans to 3D Walls" (17:25)
scope: AI-agent modelling batch, Round 1. Selected as the title closest to the owner's stated struggle; PARTIAL extraction, measurement discipline only.
notes: SELECTED BECAUSE ITS TITLE WAS THE CLOSEST IN THE BATCH TO THE STATED PROBLEM - 2D plan to 3D walls - AND THE HONEST ASSESSMENT IS THAT MOST OF IT IS WORTHLESS TO A PROGRAMMATIC PIPELINE. Push/pull to height, reversing inside-out faces, orient faces, careful group selection: all SketchUp GUI mechanics, all discarded. It was extracted for three tool-independent discipline statements. THE FIRST IS AN ADDITION TO THIS VAULT'S OWN DIMENSION-READING RULE. Tracing a wall off a raster he says he draws from about the middle of one black line to about the middle of the other, gets about five and a half inches, and then warns that the line itself is maybe an eighth or a quarter inch thick so you need to take all this with a grain of salt. TWO DISTINCT POINTS FALL OUT: reading a thickness off a raster requires FIRST CHOOSING which part of the drawn line you measure to, and an unstated choice is an unstated error; and THE DRAWN LINE'S OWN THICKNESS IS A GENUINE ERROR BAR which at plan scale can be the same order as the tolerance being claimed. Evidence_Reading_Discipline.md already requires identifying the two elements a dimension's extension lines terminate on - THIS ADDS THAT THE TERMINATING ELEMENT ITSELF HAS THICKNESS. Directly applicable to the v0 reconstruction and to the frozen ink mask, where the mask's stroke width is exactly this quantity. THE SECOND IS THE ORACLE PRINCIPLE, REACHED BY HAND BY SOMEONE WHO GOT THERE THROUGH EXPERIENCE: it does not matter how good the information you get, there is always a possibility that there is a difference between what is in the model and the actual dimension it is supposed to represent, so always double-check against printed dimensions of some sort. That is vector_extent_oracle.py's reason for existing, and note his claim is STRONGER than a habit - the check is required regardless of source quality. THE THIRD IS MILD: he refuses to treat the conversion as having one answer because how you want the walls presented changes the method - one mass, or each wall in its own container, openings now or later - which corroborates this project's wall-as-calculation-leg versus assembly-as-physical-element split from the opposite direction, as a question about how output is consumed rather than how it is measured. NO TOLERANCE FIGURES ANYWHERE - about the right size, probably around five and a half inches, a grain of salt - the discipline is qualitative by his own framing and NO numeric tolerance may be derived from it.

source_title: Aaron Dietzen / Trimble SketchUp - "How good is Claude at SketchUp modeling?" (16:34)

IT EARNS ITS PLACE ON BEHAVIOUR RATHER THAN TRUST: it states the integration's architectural limits unprompted and demonstrates a failure mode that reflects badly on the feature. An agent that defaults a wall thickness sails straight through that judgement and produces a model that looks finished and is wrong. THE MITIGATING BEHAVIOUR IS WHAT MAKES THE RULE ACTIONABLE RATHER THAN JUST ALARMING - IT DOES REPORT ITS ASSUMPTIONS - so the requirement to enumerate every supplied value is satisfiable, not aspirational. Its advantage is convenience for one-off geometry, which is not this project's problem. So on this evidence the answer is no: same architecture, weaker guarantees. GEOMETRY HYGIENE IS ACCEPTABLE - named components in the Outliner rather than a mesh soup, triangulated but quad ready, explicitly not the pathological case he has seen elsewhere where six faces arrive as 212 diagonal angle cuts. BUT THE ONLY DIMENSION CHECK SHOWN IS A 24-INCH CUBE MEASURING 2 FT ON THREE AXES, which is one trivial check on a primitive and is NOT evidence of dimensional reliability on real geometry. HE ALSO DOES NOT KNOW HOW IT RUNS - I do not know what the magic by which this happens, but it runs Trimble SketchUp somewhere somewhere somehow - so whether generation is server-side SketchUp, a headless API or code generation is UNESTABLISHED, and that matters because it decides whether the output is reproducible. source_title: Tim Fairley - "How to Get AI to Read Construction Drawings" (14:43)
scope: AI-agent modelling batch, Round 1. Selected as the most promising item; PARTIAL extraction of the pattern and the failure demonstrations only.
notes: SELECTED AS THE BATCH'S MOST PROMISING ITEM BECAUSE READING PRINTED DIMENSION STRINGS IS THIS PROJECT'S LIVE BLOCKER, AND IT TURNED OUT NOT TO BE ABOUT THAT AT ALL - THE MISMATCH IS THE MOST USEFUL THING IN IT. What it actually demonstrates, on camera rather than by assertion, is that three naive paths fail: a roughly 10 MB 25-drawing set FAILS to upload to chat, the same files FAIL through a project/RAG upload, and a folder-scoped desktop agent works but uses around 30 times the tokens - enough to exhaust a pro subscription on one drawing set - while answering LESS accurately for the same reason. His name for the cause is CONTEXT ROT: the more information we give AI, the less likely it is to answer accurately. AND ONE GENERAL LESSON FALLS OUT OF THE FIRST FAILURE - the DOCUMENTED limit and the OBSERVED limit differed, and only the observation mattered, which is the same standing warning this repo already carries about trusting an agent's self-report over its verified behaviour. HIS FIX IS TO SUMMARISE EACH DRAWING INTO A ROW OF A STRUCTURED STORE AND QUERY THAT INSTEAD OF THE DRAWINGS, with the clearest analogy in either batch: it is like giving someone 30 or 100 drawings and asking what the height of the retaining wall is, versus giving them the retaining wall drawing and telling them this is the height. CRITICALLY, THIS PROJECT ALREADY DOES THIS AND MORE STRICTLY, SO THE FINDING IS VALIDATION OF THE ARCHITECTURE RATHER THAN INSTRUCTION: data/canonical/ IS the condensed queryable store, and this project goes further because THE DRAWINGS ARE GENERATED FROM IT rather than queried alongside it, so there is no second copy to drift; and Evidence_Reading_Discipline.md plus vector_extent_oracle.py demand PROVENANCE for each extracted figure, which his summary rows do not carry. Worth stating plainly given the owner's are-we-reinventing-the-wheel question: on this axis the project is AHEAD of the practice in the video. WHAT GENUINELY TRANSFERS IS SMALL BUT ACTIONABLE: a per-drawing index as an explicit artefact, which this project lacks - it has canonical DATA but no index of what each SHEET carries, a different thing and closer to an album contents page; and the incidental note that A SPREADSHEET IS A POOR STORE BECAUSE THE WHOLE SHEET LANDS IN CONTEXT, which is equally true of reading our CSVs whole, so a query interface over the canonical layer would be the equivalent improvement. He built it in Google Antigravity, which this project already runs as one of three agents, so the path needs no new tooling. TWO REASONS TO DISCOUNT PARTS OF IT: there is NO ACCURACY MEASUREMENT of any kind - he asserts the condensed store answers much more quickly and effectively with no comparison figure, no error rate and no test - and he is explicit that he is mid-experiment. ALSO, AND THIS IS WHY IT DOES NOT CLOSE THE BLOCKER: nothing in this source addresses reading dimension strings off a drawing, so the v0 question went to the Gemini brief instead, where MEASURED error rates are explicitly demanded. AND ONE UNRESOLVED RISK WORTH CARRYING: whether the per-drawing summaries were produced by a model reading each drawing is not shown, and if they were, the pattern inherits exactly the misreading risk this vault has SEVEN recorded instances of, with no provenance in his rows to audit it.

source_title: Константин Круглов | Ontario - "Нанял 5 экспертов по домашнему свету. Вот какие светильники НЕЛЬЗЯ покупать" (41:46)
scope: Single source, fully processed. New dedicated page created; four measurable parameters added that this vault did not previously name.
notes: THE MOST USEFUL FACT IN THIS SOURCE SHARPENS A NUMBER THIS VAULT ALREADY RELIED ON RATHER THAN ADDING A NEW ONE. Lighting_Fixtures_and_Fittings.md has carried CRI should be above 95 since Renzhin. CRI is an ARITHMETIC MEAN OVER TEN SAMPLES, eight primary plus two additional, and R9 - the red sample - can be 0 underneath a CRI of 90, which is exactly why two fixtures both honestly labelled CRI 90 render skin and wood completely differently. Shown on camera in a light lab: a marketplace lamp with a high overall CRI and R9 of zero against an unbranded module with a barely higher CRI and a very high R9, the second visibly better. Cheap components cannot reach a good R9 at all - a materials limit, not a tuning failure - and makers of cheap lamps never publish the figure because a buyer who knows only CRI reads 90 and stops. The existing instruction was not wrong, it was INSUFFICIENT. A NEW PAGE WAS CREATED ON A SINGLE SOURCE, AGAINST THIS STORE OWN 3+ SOURCE THRESHOLD, ON TWO MECHANICAL GROUNDS RATHER THAN EDITORIAL ONES: Lighting_Fixtures_and_Fittings.md stood at 341 lines and this material would have carried it past the 400-line backstop that check_page_sizes.py actually fails on, and specifying a downlight by measurable parameter is a coherent self-contained subject, which is the skill own definition of a scoped case worth standing alone. The threshold rule exists to stop premature pages on thin topics, not to force a 90-line addition into a page that cannot hold it. FOUR PARAMETERS WERE GENUINELY ABSENT FROM THIS VAULT BEFORE TODAY, checked by grep across the engineering, surfaces and design folders before writing: R9, UGR, LED binning and the flicker coefficient. THE SOURCE ALSO PUTS ITSELF INTO A DIRECT DISAGREEMENT WITH SOMEONE ALREADY RECORDED HERE, AND THE ASYMMETRY IS THE INTERESTING PART: Renzhin puts the visible difference between a good and a mediocre fixture at 15-20 percent and says cheap recessed fixtures and Chinese fixtures are fine, against this source 100x with lab measurements behind it. Neither speaker is disinterested but their incentives point opposite ways - Renzhin claim runs AGAINST his commercial interest and Kruglov runs WITH his. Left unresolved as a Perspectives block. The synthesis that does not require picking a side is that they answer different questions: how different the lit room LOOKS versus how the fixtures differ as PRODUCTS, and a parameter can be real, measurable and still make only a modest difference to a finished room. RATED promotional_ratio MEDIUM RATHER THAN HIGH ON EVIDENCE, NOT CHARITY, even though a turnkey renovation company arguing upward across eight price tiers is the textbook tier-steering shape: he states you need not buy the top line, names honest budget brands at tier 2, gives a free self-test needing no purchase (film a lit fixture on a phone at minimum shutter speed and the flicker becomes visible), and gives a free third-party verification route that bypasses him entirely (take your own intended fixture to a professional lighting company and have them measure it). The parameters he argues on are objective and checkable rather than matters of taste, which is the reason this routed as data. The five experts and a laboratory credential is unverifiable - no expert named, no lab named, no report shown beyond on-screen instrument readouts - and is recorded as the source own claim about its method, which is nonetheless more methodological disclosure than most sources in this vault offer. ONE CONVENTION GAP WORTH NOTING BEFORE IT RECURS: the USD rounding convention starts at nearest 10 below $1,000, which would round the 110 RUB cheap fixture-and-lamp pair (about $1.41) to $0 and destroy the figure. Recorded as a whole dollar with an explicit note that it carries no precision beyond about one dollar. The load-bearing figure is the ratio, about 100x, which is scale-free and needs no conversion at all. ASR is noticeably worse than this vault average on technical nouns - sirai for CRI, knov/kvinov/kenov for kelvinov, demirovat for dimmirovat, svetsperedacha for tsvetoperedacha - so every figure is a single-mention candidate while the parameter names and tier structure are unambiguous from repetition. A PRACTITIONER RETRACTING HIS OWN PUBLISHED ADVICE IS THE STRONGEST FORM THIS CHANNEL OFFERS. THE ROOT CAUSE IS THE BEST MECHANISM IN THE ROUND. Agentic harnesses - Claude Code, Cowork, Cursor, Antigravity - ALL GREW OUT OF SOFTWARE ENGINEERING AND WERE NOT DESIGNED FOR KNOWLEDGE WORK, so pointing them at folders of Word documents and spreadsheets and PDFs uses them against their design. Git works on code because code is many small plain-text files, deliberately structured, WHERE A CHANGE TOUCHES A FEW LINES - and thirty years of tooling is built on that: diffs, branches, pull requests, per-line attribution, history. THE KEY INSIGHT IS THAT GIT WORKS BECAUSE THE UNIT IS A LINE, AND IN KNOWLEDGE WORK THE UNIT IS THE WHOLE FILE: to read one row of a register the model ingests the entire workbook, and TO CHANGE ONE CELL IT MUST REWRITE THE ENTIRE DOCUMENT. Three consequences follow - concurrent writes collide and you get two versions of one register with no way to tell which is right, folders fill with duplicates and stray files, AND EVERY READ IS THE WHOLE FILE SO IT IS NOT TOKEN-EFFICIENT EITHER. He is careful that this predates agents, since SharePoint has always had it and agents merely make it acute, and HE SCOPES IT HONESTLY - if you have only two people working in the same folder it is probably not a big issue. HIS PROPOSED ARCHITECTURE, STATED AS PROVISIONAL AND NOT STRESS-TESTED: each person harness open in a LOCAL folder with only what the task needs; SHARED CONTEXT IN A GIT REPOSITORY reached over MCP, because git is a very token efficient way for AI to read and access information; LIVE REGISTERS IN A DATABASE RATHER THAN A SPREADSHEET, optionally read-only so the agent cannot write; static documents copied locally; and THE HUMAN AS GATEKEEPER of what gets published. THE STRIKING THING IS THAT THIS PROJECT IS ALREADY ON THAT ARCHITECTURE AND ARRIVED THERE LARGELY BY DEFAULT RATHER THAN BY DECISION: shared context in a git repository, PLAIN TEXT AND CSV RATHER THAN EXCEL so that changes ARE line-level diffs and GIT IS THE CONCURRENCY CONTROL - the exact property he identifies as missing from knowledge work - human gatekeeping and STRONGER THAN HIS because we have deterministic gates rather than a person eyeballing output, and agents scoped to a folder. ONE DELIBERATE DIVERGENCE RECORDED RATHER THAN FOLLOWED: he routes live registers to a DATABASE while this project keeps them as CSV IN GIT. For many concurrent writers a database is right; FOR ONE PERSON WITH VERSION CONTROL, CSV-IN-GIT DIFFS AND REVIEWS AND REVERTS AND NEEDS NO SECOND SYSTEM. A fork in the road, not a correction. THE PIPELINE IS FOUR STAGES: a section box whose face handles set the cut plane; generate cross-section and elevation drawings from it; EXPORT THOSE DRAWINGS AS MESHES with a clean-up option, into their own collection; dimension them with MeasureIt_ARCH, then set a camera, an A3 paper size and orientation and an output path, and run the render vector operator to emit SVG. STRUCTURALLY IDENTICAL TO WHAT THIS PROJECT ALREADY DOES - cut the model, extract 2D, annotate, place on a sheet, emit vector - THE DIFFERENCE IS ONLY WHICH ENGINE PERFORMS EACH STAGE, which confirms the stage decomposition is standard and not a local invention. THE EXTRACTION MAIN CONTENT IS THREE WAYS THIS PIPELINE SILENTLY PRODUCES A WRONG DRAWING, each a case where the export SUCCEEDS and the sheet is WRONG, and in each case the presenter only knows because he has hit it before. A - EDGES BELOW AN ANGLE THRESHOLD ARE SILENTLY DROPPED: as you notice IT DID NOT TAKE ALL THE EDGES INTO ACCOUNT because THESE EDGES HAVE A VERY LOW ANGLE, simply increase the crease angle, 175 degrees should be fine, then remove the elevation and recreate it. A GENERATED DRAWING CAN OMIT REAL GEOMETRY AND STILL LOOK FINISHED, and the omission is a function of a threshold parameter so it is SYSTEMATIC - every edge below the crease angle disappears from every sheet, and near-coplanar surfaces like a shallow ramp a slight level change or a chamfer are exactly the geometry a renovation drawing must show. RAISING THE THRESHOLD COSTS TIME AND HE SAYS SO - this takes even longer because more edges means more calculations - WHICH IS THE PRESSURE THAT KEEPS PEOPLE ON A LOSSY DEFAULT. B - THE DRAWING OWN LINES ARE NOT EXPORTED UNLESS A LINE GROUP IS CREATED: if we would export everything now WE WOULD ONLY SEE THE DIMENSIONS, this because we have to add a line group to our mesh, and ACTUALLY IT LOOKS LIKE NOTHING HAPPENED. THE DEFAULT EXPORT YIELDS THE ANNOTATIONS WITHOUT THE GEOMETRY - a sheet of dimension strings floating over nothing - AND IT IS A TOTAL SILENT OMISSION WHOSE ENABLING STEP GIVES NO VISIBLE FEEDBACK WHEN PERFORMED. The purest example in the batch of a step you can only get right by already knowing about it. C - DXF EXPORT HAS ACKNOWLEDGED SCALING ISSUES: search for render to dxf and execute this one BUT BE AWARE OF SOME SCALING ISSUES THAT MIGHT HAPPEN, and therefore check out the documentation where they go in detail about how to fix these issues. AN EXPORT PATH WITH KNOWN UNQUANTIFIED SCALE DEFECTS IS DISQUALIFYING FOR THIS PROJECT, NOT A CAUTION - every gate here is dimensional and check_dxf_closure.py asserts drawn length and thickness against the record and against the PDF hatched solids; A ROUTE WHOSE OWN DOCUMENTATION HAS A SECTION ON FIXING ITS SCALING IS NOT A ROUTE WE CAN PUT A DELIVERABLE THROUGH, whatever its annotation quality. TEXT COLLISION IS HANDLED MANUALLY HERE TOO, WHICH QUALIFIES THE ADOPT DECISION. The gap analysis stated reason for adopting Bonsai drawings is that hand-rolling fails exactly on dimension chains colliding and text overlaps - AND THIS SOURCE SHOWS THE SAME FAILURE INSIDE A PURPOSE-BUILT ANNOTATION ADD-ON, FIXED ONE DIMENSION AT A TIME BY HAND: a dimension whose arrows point inwards found by hiding entries one by one in a list to identify it then setting tweak distance to minus 1 to flip it outward; a dimension too narrow for its own text - this is way too narrow to fit the text in here, IT GETS BLIND OUTSIDE - fixed by setting that dimension alignment to left; and defaults unusable at architectural scale, font size raised to 30, line weight to 2, arrow size to 30, because it is way too thin and the font is way too small. ADOPTING A TOOL DOES NOT SOLVE THE TEXT-COLLISION PROBLEM, IT RELOCATES IT. The add-on has a NAMED STYLE SET which is a real advantage since one edit restyles every dimension using it, BUT PER-DIMENSION PLACEMENT REMAINS A MANUAL OVERRIDE. THIS DOES NOT OVERTURN THE ADOPT VERDICT SINCE BONSAI IS A DIFFERENT TOOL AND MAY DO BETTER, BUT IT REMOVES THE ASSUMPTION UNDERNEATH IT, and the honest form of the open question becomes DOES BONSAI DRAWING SUBSYSTEM PLACE DIMENSION TEXT WITHOUT PER-INSTANCE INTERVENTION AND IS THAT PLACEMENT REACHABLE HEADLESS - PLACEMENT, NOT ANNOTATION CAPABILITY, IS WHAT DECIDES WHETHER AN ANNOTATED SHEET CAN BE GENERATED BY MAKE. MECHANISM WORTH KEEPING - a named style set is the right abstraction, dimension style and line style separate and scene-level, which is what our SVG pipeline should have if it keeps the annotated sheets: a single style object, not per-element attributes. ANNOTATION DEFAULTS ARE AUTHORED FOR OBJECT SCALE NOT BUILDING SCALE - every figure needed multiplying by roughly an order of magnitude, so ANY GENERATED SHEET NEEDS AN EXPLICIT STYLE PASS AND THERE IS NO USABLE DEFAULT. Background set to white before annotating, the same presentation-pass instinct already recorded. Sheet setup is camera plus view plus paper size plus orientation plus output path, with the path testable before export by a button that opens the browser - VERIFY THE OUTPUT LOCATION BEFORE RUNNING A LONG EXPORT. DRAWINGS LIVE IN THEIR OWN COLLECTION with the source model and section boxes disabled, so THE DRAWING IS A SEPARATE ARTEFACT FROM THE MODEL AND NOT A VIEW OF IT - AND THAT IS THE WEAKNESS OF THIS WHOLE ROUTE, SINCE ONCE EXPORTED AS MESHES THE DRAWINGS NO LONGER TRACK THE MODEL. It is the placed-not-associated defect arriving in the drawing layer, and A DIMENSION ON AN EXPORTED MESH CANNOT KNOW ITS MODEL CHANGED. THE CUT PLANE IS SET BY DRAGGING A BOX HANDLE BY EYE AND NO CUT HEIGHT IS STATED OR ENTERED NUMERICALLY ANYWHERE IN THE VIDEO - for a plan cut the height is a convention with consequences about which openings appear and which are dashed above, and AN UNSTATED CUT HEIGHT IS AN UNSTATED DRAWING CONVENTION. notes: STATED IN THE FIRST SENTENCE: today we are going to be doing CUSTOM LINE WEIGHTS, LINE STYLES AND HATCH PATTERNS USING CSS, it is not too complicated but it is tedious. THE STYLESHEET IS A REAL .css FILE copied from the add-on data/styles/ directory, PLACED BESIDE THE IFC FILE - THEY HAVE TO BE IN THE SAME PLACE - and referenced per drawing: select the camera, EPset_drawing, at the bottom which is STYLESHEET, we are just going to write tut.css, SO THIS LETS THIS CAMERA REFERENCE THAT CSS FILE. THE SVG+CSS ARCHITECTURE IS NOW CONFIRMED FROM ALL FOUR SIDES - drawings open in a browser, sheets are SVG files in a directory, sheet filtering uses a CSS attribute selector, AND THE STYLING IS A CSS FILE THE USER EDITS IN NOTEPAD. NOTE THE SCOPING WHICH IS THE GOOD HALF: THE STYLESHEET LIVES WITH THE PROJECT and the reference is a per-drawing property, so different sheets can carry different stylesheets - exactly the right shape and trivially git-trackable. THE CORRECTION: THE UNDOCUMENTED MAGIC STRINGS ARE CSS CLASS NAMES. Earlier notes in this batch described brick concrete earth and SEALANT as undocumented unvalidated case-sensitive magic-string vocabularies with contradictory conventions. THEY ARE CSS CLASSES DEFINED IN A FILE THE USER CAN OPEN AND READ - to add a custom line style he appends a rule and names it GREEN with stroke green lowercase and stroke-width two and a dash-array, then sets the element OBJECT TYPE attribute to green: where it says object type you want this to just be WHATEVER YOU LABEL THE PREDEFINED TYPE. THE VOCABULARY IS NOT MAGIC AND NOT FIXED, IT IS WHATEVER THE STYLESHEET DEFINES AND IT IS USER-EXTENSIBLE, and the casing inconsistency is not a convention at all, just how the shipped default stylesheet happens to be written. TWO THINGS FROM THE EARLIER NOTES SURVIVE AND ONE DOES NOT - SURVIVES: nothing validates that a name typed into an attribute matches a class that exists, A TYPO YIELDS NO HATCH AND NO ERROR so the IDS argument stands unchanged; SURVIVES: the earlier presenter had to flash the valid list on screen because it is not discoverable IN THE UI; DOES NOT SURVIVE: calling it undocumented, IT IS DOCUMENTED IN THE STYLESHEET WHICH IS THE FILE YOU ARE MEANT TO EDIT. THE STYLING TAXONOMY IS THE RIGHT ONE TO COPY - the stylesheet is organised by THE ELEMENT ROLE IN THE DRAWING not by element class: CUT for anything the camera plane passes through, PROJECTION for anything seen beyond the cut, TEXT, ANNOTATION, PREDEFINED TYPES described as purely 2D elements and user-extensible, and MATERIAL described as a 3D element that references a 2D pattern. DEMONSTRATED - setting text blue and cut red turns wall cut lines red and text blue WHILE THE WINDOW AND SANITARYWARE SYMBOLS AND THE ANNOTATIONS DO NOT CHANGE because they belong to different categories. CUT VERSUS PROJECTION IS FIRST-CLASS AND IT IS THE FUNDAMENTAL DISTINCTION IN ARCHITECTURAL DRAWING - what is cut is heavy and poched, what is beyond is light - AND OUR OWN SVG GENERATOR SHOULD BE ORGANISED THE SAME WAY, style by role in the view plus material for fill rather than by element type. THE MOST DIRECTLY COPYABLE DESIGN IN THE ROUND AND IT NEEDS NO BONSAI. A HATCH REQUIRES TWO REGISTRATIONS IN TWO FILES WITH MATCHING NAMES: the PATTERN is an SVG pattern in data/templates/patterns each starting with a label a width a height a rotation and the spacing, he adds red brick at width 2 height 2 with stroke red; then WE NEED TO CREATE THE MATERIAL IN THE CSS FILE, copying the existing brick material rule and relabelling it red brick; then set the wall material layer set name to red brick. DEFINE ONE WITHOUT THE OTHER AND YOU GET NOTHING - a two-file coupling held together by a string with no check that the halves agree, A THIRD CONCRETE RULE FOR IDS and a caution for any styling system we build: ONE DEFINITION, ONE PLACE. THE SCOPING IS INCONSISTENT AND IT DECIDES HOW ANY OF THIS COULD BE ADOPTED HERE: the STYLESHEET lives beside the IFC referenced per drawing and is project-local and git-trackable; HATCH PATTERNS live inside the add-on install and THAT CHANGES EVERY BLENDER FILE FOR THIS VERSION so they are global and lost on reinstall; TITLE BLOCKS likewise, IF YOU REINSTALL THIS FILE WILL DEFAULT TO JUST THESE THREE SO YOU WILL LOSE YOUR CUSTOM TITLE BLOCK; MARKERS SYMBOLS AND VIEW TITLES likewise. FOUR OF THE FIVE STYLING ARTEFACTS LIVE IN THE APPLICATION INSTALL DIRECTORY NOT WITH THE PROJECT - they are version-global, shared across every project, and destroyed by a reinstall. FOR THIS REPOSITORY THAT IS CLOSE TO DISQUALIFYING ON ITS OWN TERMS INDEPENDENT OF DRAWING QUALITY, since every gate here rests on artefacts being committed hashed and diffable - the frozen ink mask, the committed registration, the archived transcripts, data/canonical/ - and A DELIVERABLE WHOSE APPEARANCE DEPENDS ON FILES IN AppData/Roaming IS NOT REPRODUCIBLE, with a rebuild on another machine silently producing differently-styled sheets. IF ANY PART IS ADOPTED THE STYLING ARTEFACTS MUST BE COPIED INTO THE REPO AND INSTALLED INTO PLACE BY THE BUILD, NOT EDITED IN SITU - the presenter himself works around it by hand, MAKE SURE THAT YOU COPY THIS SOMEWHERE SAFE. CONVENTION FINDINGS: LINE WEIGHT CONVENTIONS ARE NATIONAL AND HE FLAGS HIS OWN - I have also made my own more extensive custom line weights but I think it is good for people to just start with this because THOSE ARE VERY SOUTH AFRICAN STANDARDY. A JURISDICTION FLAG FOR THIS ENTIRE CHANNEL, confirmed again in jTL3a6QwckA where he saves MY SOUTH AFRICAN STANDARD 220 MASONRY WALL - EVERY DRAWING CONVENTION FROM THESE SOURCES CARRIES AN UNSTATED NATIONAL DEFAULT and line weights especially, NOTHING FROM HIM IS A BELARUSIAN CONVENTION AND STANDING RULE 4 APPLIES. HE OVERRIDES A NATIONAL CONVENTION ON PERSONAL PREFERENCE - of the default section arrowheads, WHICH I DON'T REALLY LIKE BECAUSE THEY ARE LIKE REVIT ARROWHEADS, I KNOW THIS IS STANDARD IN A LOT OF COUNTRIES BUT I JUST PREFER A NORMAL ARROW - recorded neutrally as an instance of exactly that: A SHIPPED DEFAULT IS SOMEBODY CONVENTION AND IT IS BEING REPLACED BY SOMEBODY ELSE. DIMENSION TICK MARKS ARE SVG MARKER DEFINITIONS in the markers template, resized by halving every value. SECTION MARKS ARE SYMBOL DEFINITIONS in the symbols template and HE SUPPRESSES THE TAG BY ZEROING ITS VALUES rather than by any supported means. THE VIEW-TITLE MARKER CARRIES SEPARATE SIZE ENTRIES PER FONT, one set for Arial and one for OpenGost, so a size change must be made in both - a maintenance smell and a hint that the templates are hand-maintained rather than generated. ANOTHER HAND-FINISHING ADMISSION - I STILL DON'T KNOW HOW TO MOVE THESE GUYS AWAY OR DELETE THEM BUT AT THE MOMENT I JUST DELETE THEM AFTERWARDS IN INKSCAPE ANYWAY - THIRD INSTANCE IN THIS ROUND OF THE FINAL SHEET BEING HAND-FINISHED IN THE VECTOR EDITOR after the arrangement and the clip workaround, so THE BONSAI TO INKSCAPE TO PDF PATH IS NOT A PIPELINE WITH AN OPTIONAL MANUAL STEP, THE MANUAL STEP IS LOAD-BEARING. A COMPARATIVE CLAIM RECORDED NOT EVALUATED - it is a lot easier than editing patterns in Revit for instance without extra add-ons and stuff - NO VERDICT ROUTED. NOTHING IS MEASURED OR VERIFIED. NO PRICES. NO REGULATORY CONTENT. DATED - the styling system is architectural and unlikely to have moved but the directory layout and the shipped default stylesheet certainly have; CONFIRM AGAINST OUR INSTALLED BONSAI 0.8.6-alpha260801 BEFORE RELYING ON ANY PATH.

scope: @IfcArchitect Tier 1; PROCESSED IN FULL. Bonsai-era, no dating caveat. Carries the round SCOPING DECISION for the owner.
notes: THE SCOPING FACT OF THE ROUND IS THAT TO DRAW A DETAIL YOU MUST MODEL THE CONSTRUCTION AT DETAIL RESOLUTION. To produce one roof-eaves detail he does not draft a single line of the construction, he models it - an IfcBeam batten on a project-wide 50x50 rectangular profile rotated 5 degrees to the roof pitch; ARRAYED AT 300 MM SPACING via a parametric array modifier, if you were doing the entire structure you would want the battens to go all the way to the end it will probably be about 12; the roof slab moved down onto the battens then given a 50 MM OVERHANG by pulling one edge; a FASCIA BOARD as a second beam on a new 20x300 profile rotated 5 degrees and snapped to the roof edge; and a CEILING as an IfcCovering sized to the room and angled to the roof. A DETAIL SHEET IS NOT A DRAWING TASK, IT IS A MODELLING TASK AT A FINER RESOLUTION THAN THE REST OF THE MODEL AND THE DRAWING FALLS OUT OF IT. THIS IS THE MOST CONSEQUENTIAL SCOPING FACT IN THE ROUND FOR THIS PROJECT AND IT IS A COST NOT A BENEFIT - our model is NOMINAL PLUS MINUS 50 MM with walls as solids from data/canonical/ and NO BATTENS NO LAYERS WITHIN A BUILD-UP AND NO FIXINGS, so NOTHING IN IT CAN PRODUCE A CONSTRUCTION DETAIL, and closing that gap means modelling the construction at a different resolution with a different data set and a different maintenance burden from everything check_dxf_closure.py currently gates. IT SHARPENS THE CHOICE FOR Sheet_Production_Roadmap.md INTO THREE HONEST OPTIONS NONE OF WHICH IS FREE: ONE model at detail resolution where a detail is genuinely needed, expensive and the gated geometry chain would have to extend to cover it; TWO draft details in 2D, cheap but it inherits the known trap that A DRAFTED-ONLY ELEMENT IS INVISIBLE TO TAKE-OFF and per r0ebxigzM6U AN UNCLASSIFIED MODELLED OBJECT IS NOT EVEN DRAWN; THREE DO NOT ISSUE DETAILS AT ALL, legitimate for a fit-out where the trades own their own build-ups AND IT SHOULD BE A STATED SCOPE DECISION RATHER THAN A SILENT OMISSION, and the vault already has the principle - A SHEET MAY LEGITIMATELY BE BLANK AND THE ALBUM SHOULD SAY SO. FLAGGED FOR THE OWNER AS A DECISION NOT RESOLVED HERE. A DETAIL IS A SECTION WITH A SMALL EXTENT AND A BIG SCALE AND NEEDS NO NEW MACHINERY - we are going to select SECTION, select EAST, RENAME THIS DETAIL ONE, adjust the WIDTH AND HEIGHT TO BE ABOUT 1000, change the scale from 1 to 100 to 1 TO 10 - so there is no callout or detail drawing type, A DETAIL IS THE SECTION GENERATOR WITH EXTENT 1000 AND SCALE 1:10 against the section 7500 at 1:100, confirming the one-camera-primitive finding from the fourth corner. BUT EVEN A FULLY MODELLED DETAIL STILL NEEDS 2D DRAFTING ON TOP, which is the honest complication: after modelling everything he still adds a BATTING ANNOTATION FOR INSULATION, a dedicated primitive 150 thick where THE LENGTH IS AUTO-CALCULATED SO YOU DON'T HAVE TO DO THE SPACING LIKE WE USED TO BEFORE, then nudged 75 mm to sit centred on the ceiling; a FILL AREA for sealant; and FINE LINES DRAWN BY HAND OVER THE BATTENS just so I know it has been cut, MANUAL 2D LINEWORK OVER GEOMETRY THAT IS ALREADY MODELLED AND ALREADY CUT. THE DETAIL IS A HYBRID OF MODELLED CONSTRUCTION PLUS DRAWN CONVENTION - insulation is not modelled because nobody models insulation, a sealant bead is not modelled because it is a bead, AND SOME OF THE DRAWN LINEWORK EXISTS PURELY TO MAKE THE CUT LEGIBLE. So option two is not really an alternative to option one, EVERY DETAIL IS SOME OF BOTH AND THE QUESTION IS WHERE THE LINE SITS. The batting auto-calculated length is THE ONE PIECE OF GENUINE AUTOMATION FOUND ANYWHERE IN BONSAI ANNOTATION SYSTEM and is worth naming as the counter-example: IT CAN BE DONE, IT JUST MOSTLY IS NOT. TEXT OVERFLOW FIXED BY SHRINKING THE FONT, THE THIRD INDEPENDENT INSTANCE - the long specification leader overruns, AND YOU CAN SEE IT IS OVERLAPPING, so maybe I want to make this a bit smaller, ADJUST THE FONT SIZE TO 1.5, and there it all fits in perfectly. After MeasureIt_ARCH and the dimension work in Part 2, THE OPEN ITEM DOES BONSAI PLACE DIMENSION TEXT WITHOUT PER-INSTANCE INTERVENTION IS NOW ANSWERED THREE TIMES OVER: IT DOES NOT, AND NEITHER DOES ANYTHING ELSE IN THIS MATERIAL. The gap analysis premise that hand-rolling fails SPECIFICALLY on text collision and a tool would fix it DOES NOT SURVIVE, which makes our generative route where offsets are computed from data we already hold NO WORSE AND PROBABLY BETTER. A SECOND STYLING VOCABULARY WITH THE OPPOSITE CASING - the sealant fill appearance is set by typing SEALANT ALL CAPS into object type, SO THIS IS A DEFAULT MATERIAL TYPE - hatch materials are lowercase and fill-area object types are all caps, two unvalidated case-sensitive vocabularies with contradictory conventions, and in this video the only way to learn either is to watch someone type it since he flashes the valid list on screen. CORRECTED LATER THE SAME ROUND BY dPWQbjaeoyo - THESE ARE CSS CLASS NAMES, the stylesheet is a literal .css file so the vocabulary is user-extensible and documented in that file, not magic just not surfaced in the UI, and THE CASING INCONSISTENCY IS AN ARTEFACT OF THE SHIPPED DEFAULT STYLESHEET NOT A CONVENTION. THE PREVIEW IS NOT THE DRAWING AND YOU MUST PRINT TO SEE THE TRUTH, stated twice unprompted - THERE IS A PREVIEW BUT YOU ARE GOING TO SEE JUST NOW THAT IT IS NOT TOO ACCURATE, BUT WHEN IT PRINTS IT IS PERFECT; and IT IS PREVIEWING THE TEXT OVER THAT SPACE, IT IS NOT ALWAYS EXACTLY PERFECT. THE VIEWPORT IS INDICATIVE AND THE PRINTED SVG IS AUTHORITATIVE, and he regenerates and re-views after nearly every change. MILDLY ENCOURAGING FOR THE HEADLESS QUESTION - THE AUTHORITATIVE RENDER IS ALREADY THE BATCH PRINT PATH NOT THE INTERACTIVE VIEWPORT, so a pipeline that never opens the viewport is not missing a more accurate view, it is using the accurate one; it also means A GUI USER CANNOT TRUST WHAT THEY SEE WHILE PLACING ANNOTATIONS which is part of why placement takes so long. THE ANATOMY OF A SPECIFICATION NOTE IS WORTH COPYING AS A SHAPE - his leader reads 50 mm roof sheeting fixed to timber battens at 300 centres, installed PER MANUFACTURER INSTRUCTIONS, on 200x3 mm steel C channels at 1200 centre to centres, at 5 degree slope, PER ENGINEER SPEC. The structure is MATERIAL PLUS SIZE then FIXING then SPACING then DEFERRAL TO THE MANUFACTURER then SUBSTRATE PLUS SIZE then ITS SPACING then GEOMETRY then DEFERRAL TO ANOTHER PARTY. THE TWO DEFERRALS ARE THE TRANSFERABLE PART - per manufacturer instructions and per engineer spec are THE NOTE NAMING WHO OWNS THE DECISIONS IT DELIBERATELY DOES NOT STATE, which is the responsibility-seam principle already in our Drawing_Conventions arriving at the annotation level instead of the layer level: A NOTE THAT STATES EVERYTHING IS CLAIMING AUTHORITY IT MAY NOT HAVE, A NOTE THAT DEFERS IS SCOPING ITSELF. THE CONSTRUCTION DESCRIBED IS A PITCHED TIMBER-AND-STEEL ROOF AND IS IRRELEVANT TO THIS FLAT, the figures are not routed. PROJECT-SCOPED NAMED OBJECTS - A PROFILE IS A PROJECT-WIDE NAMED OBJECT like a material and a type, he creates 50x50 and 20x300 rectangular profiles then assigns each to a beam material, so BONSAI MODEL IS CONSISTENTLY TYPES PLUS PROFILES PLUS MATERIALS ALL PROJECT-SCOPED ALL NAMED ALL REUSABLE - a good shape and our own data already resembles it since wall_materials.json is the same idea. IfcCovering IS THE CLASS FOR A CEILING, created from a duplicated cover 30 type renamed cover 20 - DIRECTLY RELEVANT since this project will need ceilings and surface finishes. ARRAY DIRECTION IS CHOSEN BY TRIAL AND ERROR - let us just check which direction it goes, YOU CAN SEE THAT IS THE WRONG DIRECTION, we probably want the X - with local or global space an option picked by looking, A FOURTH INSTANCE OF THE IMPLICIT-DIRECTION AND ANCHOR THEME after the wall-direction convention the bottom-left-of-wall datum and text alignment by origin: SOMETHING ALWAYS CHOOSES AN AXIS AND IT IS RARELY STATED. A newline in annotation text is backslash n or you can add a literal. NOTHING IS MEASURED OR VERIFIED. NO PRICES. NO REGULATORY CONTENT.

THREE - ANYTHING ELSE DROPPED INTO THE CUTTERS COLLECTION IS SUBTRACTED FROM THE WALLS, including objects created while that collection happened to be active.
